sn35.219-221:1.1: Rūpā bhikkhave anattā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso hamasmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā anattā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso hamasmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti
